desc: ​The Rizzini BR220 Light is a premium over-and-under shotgun designed for discerning hunters seeking a lightweight yet robust firearm. It features a lightweight alloy frame adorned with light coin finish and game scene engraving, complemented by a gold trigger. The shotgun is available in 12, 16, 20, 28, and .410 gauges, with frames properly scaled to each gauge for optimal balance. Its Grade 2.5 Turkish Walnut stock, featuring a Prince of Wales grip and 26 LPI checkering, enhances both aesthetics and handling. The BR220 Light is equipped with nickel chrome steel barrels with vented ribs, offered in standard lengths of 28" and 29", with 26" and 30" options available upon request. Weighing between 5.3 lbs (.410 gauge) and 6.6 lbs (12 gauge), this shotgun ensures ease of carry without compromising performance.
